block_classification.all_pass: max_date <= threshold → aggregate entire block without per-row date check
block_classification.partial: scan rows individually with per-row predicate

key_encoding.description: Use a 256-entry lookup table mapping ASCII char to compact index. returnflag: A→0, N→1, R→2. linestatus: F→0, O→1. Combined key = returnflag_idx * 2 + linestatus_idx. Max index = 5, allocate array of 6 slots.

aggregation.avg_computation: deferred to finalize: avg_qty = sum_qty/count, avg_price = sum_base_price/count, avg_disc = sum_discount/count

parallelism.merge: sum thread-local accumulator arrays (6 slots each) into global result
parallelism.notes: Each thread maintains a local array[6] of accumulator structs. No synchronization during scan. Single merge at end.

data_structures.aggregation: fixed_array(6 slots, indexed by compact key)
data_structures.thread_local_accumulators: array[6] per thread, cache-line aligned to avoid false sharing

output.sort_strategy: trivial — iterate compact keys 0..5 in order, output non-empty groups

optimization_notes.io_strategy: mmap all 7 column files; OS prefetch handles sequential scan
optimization_notes.vectorized_scan: process blocks of 65536 rows; for all-pass blocks skip per-row date check
optimization_notes.computation: compute (1 - discount) once per row, reuse for both sum_disc_price and sum_charge
